statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let budget := fun x : ℕ => (x : ℝ) * Real.log (x : ℝ); let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); let primes := fun x : ℕ => (Finset.Ioc x ((2*x)^2+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p^100000 ≤ (2*x)^132301); let window := fun x p : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun n => p^100000 ≤ n^132301); let angle := fun p k : ℕ => fun t : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * k * t / p; let coef := fun a x p k : ℕ => (∑ r ∈ roots a p, ∑ n ∈ window x p, Real.cos (angle p k ((n : ℝ) - r))) / p; let freqs := fun (p : ℕ) (low : Bool) => (Finset.Ico 1 p).filter (fun k => if low then min k (p-k) ≤ Nat.sqrt p else Nat.sqrt p < min k (p-k)); let part := fun (a x p : ℕ) (low : Bool) => (∑ k ∈ freqs p low, coef a x p k) * Real.log (p : ℝ); let modes := fun (a x : ℕ) (low : Bool) => ∑ p ∈ primes x, part a x p low; ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ x ≥ X, modes 1 x true ≤ (1/5 : ℝ)*budget x

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0040 · 将两个素数段的低频和统一压到 1/5
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0040 · Budget 1/5 uniformly for the signed low modes

brief.zh: 条件组合由 QP-0038、0039 给出。总上界本身仍开放，合并时取两个最终阈值的最大值并相加 3/25 与 2/25。
brief.en: The aggregate bound is open. Given QP-0038 and QP-0039, use the larger threshold and add 3/25 and 2/25.
